name: Need for Speed: Carbon Collector's Edition - Recompiled (Europe)

inputs.label: Your disc image (.iso) of Need for Speed: Carbon Collector's Edition for Xbox 360, European release (default.xex version 0.0.0.11), or its extracted folder with default.xex. The USA release does not run with this build.

actions.label: Savegames
actions.help: Your career and settings saved by the game.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so later races don't stutter. Clearing only helps if graphics look wrong after an update.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The log of each session, and a dump file after a crash. Attach them when you report a problem.
